en: Theragāthā 3.13 Tikanipāta, Paṭhamavagga The Elder Vītasoka I have crossed over the flood; I am free from all bonds. Having abandoned all attachments, I dwell without clinging. I have attained peace; I am cooled and free from fever. I have reached the state of peace; I am one who has done what was to be done. I am a sage, one whose taints are destroyed, One who has reached the end of the journey and stands at the goal.
